source_title: Find Out When Phantom Blade Zero Unlocks and How Much Space It Needs - GameRant
source_excerpt:
Phantom Blade Zero is set to release on October 29, 2026, for PS5 and PC, although players in the United States and some other regions will be able to start playing on October 28. Although the Digital Deluxe Edition offers additional outfits and digital extras, there is no early access period, so all players can start at the same time. Here's when the game releases in your region, when you can pre-load it, and whether the Digital Deluxe Edition is worth the extra cost.
The physical version of the game will be released in 2027, with the exact date still unannounced.
Phantom Blade Zero launches on October 28 at 7:00 PM PDT in the United States, which corresponds to 10:00 PM Eastern Time and October 29 at 10:00 AM in China. The game has a simultaneous global launch, so players across different regions can start playing at the same moment, with the local date and time varying by time zone.
China / Singapore / Hong Kong (CST/SGT/HKT)
When Does Phantom Blade Zero Pre-Load Start (Install Size)
Players can pre-load Phantom Blade Zero on both PS5 and PC before launch, allowing them to download the game in advance rather than wait for the full download after release. The file size for this 25-hour main story game is expected to be around 145 GB, so make sure you have enough storage space available.
Pre-loading begins on October 26, 2026, at 7:00 PM PDT.
Is Phantom Blade Zero's Deluxe Edition Worth It?
The Digital Deluxe Edition costs $69.99, which is $10 more than the Standard Edition at $59.99. Both editions include the full game and the standard pre-order bonuses, which are the Treasure Basin accessory that increases Remnant Dust drops by 10% and the Legacy outfit .
The Digital Deluxe Edition also includes two exclusive outfits, Wulin Legend and Blood-Steel Form , along with a digital artbook and digital soundtrack. There is no early access for Deluxe Edition owners, and the pre-order bonuses can also be obtained through in-game progression.
If you want the extra outfits and digital extras, the additional $10 may be worth it, but there is no gameplay head start for buying the more expensive edition.
